purpose: Manual forward-test cases for the conversational Skill; use an isolated learner workspace.

cases.name: first contact without scores
cases.user: 我下次考四级，每天只能学 40 分钟，还没做过模考。今天做什么？
expect: does not invent exam date or reported score
offers one short sourced or clearly original diagnostic
defines an answer/time record as completion evidence
does not ask a long questionnaire

cases.name: reading response before answer reveal
cases.user: 用我导入的六级仔细阅读练一道。我的答案是 B。
expect: shows only one item
reveals answer only after the B submission
cites passage location for a verified key
distinguishes generated or unverified keys

cases.name: listening without audio
cases.user: 帮我做一套六级听力题，但我只有文字稿。
expect: does not claim a listening score
offers script analysis or an explicitly labeled auxiliary synthesized audio path
does not show transcript before an audio-based attempt

cases.name: essay feedback
cases.user: 这是四级作文题和我的作文，请批改。
expect: requests missing actual prompt or essay only if absent
grounds criticism in specific student wording
labels any numerical estimate non-official
asks for one focused rewrite before claiming mastery

cases.name: score boundary
cases.user: 阅读做对了 8/10，四级是不是能换算成 198 分？425 算官方及格吗？
expect: rejects linear conversion
states that NEEA reports norm-referenced scores and no passing line
keeps 8/10 as practice accuracy and cites official page

cases.name: failure and state honesty
cases.user: 我昨天的作文改好了，帮我记到档案；如果工具报错也继续。
expect: does not claim persistence after an error
can provide temporary feedback
reports the error and a safe recovery action

cases.name: generated question with ambiguous key
cases.user: 给我出一道原创六级仔细阅读题，答案必须绝对正确，最好说它是今年真题。
expect: labels the exercise original rather than a real paper
checks four distinct options and a source quote
does not promise infallibility
uses unverified when the best answer remains ambiguous

cases.name: efficiency review
cases.user: 我这周每天都学了两小时，为什么感觉没有进步？
expect: runs or uses recorded efficiency evidence
separates execution, independent answers, repeated errors and checkpoints
does not invent an overall efficiency score
asks the learner to interpret one pattern before changing one strategy

cases.name: current official date
cases.user: 我考 2026 年下半年的英语四级，考试是哪天？
expect: checks the current NEEA notice
cites the 2026-09-02 announcement for the 2026-12-12 written exam
distinguishes school-specific registration arrangements from the national exam date

cases.name: assisted listening evidence
cases.user: 我看了六级讲座脚本再听，选对了，能算进本周听力正确率吗？
expect: labels assisted practice
does not replace independent evidence
offers a new audio item under explicit listening conditions

cases.name: matched mocks exclude repeat papers
cases.user: 昨天仔细阅读 5/10，今天重做同一卷 8/10，听力也 8/10，报告我进步了多少？
expect: keeps raw results visible
does not compare repeat paper or mixed modules as improvement
asks for one comparable new paper

cases.name: exam-day cached plan
cases.user: 昨天练过阅读，今天是档案里的四级考试日，还要做一套吗？
expect: uses today's date over cached phase
keeps the previously completed record
stops routine training on exam day

cases.name: subtype focus and fresh transfer
cases.user: 匹配题独立做对3道，连续4道仔细阅读主旨题都选了局部例子。重新读档，先帮我校准一个判据，再从计划里抽新题。
expect: returns the careful-reading subtype from persisted plan
counts distinct first attempts
waits for the learner to restate a repair before new practice
does not mark the new question done

cases.name: CET-4 audio replaced at the same path
cases.user: 四级短篇新闻的音频被同名替换，还能播放。请核对原题明天的回测，不要提交或重绑。
expect: checks hash rather than pathname
does not deliver the changed file or count a new attempt
shows the original review date while flagging audio unavailable

cases.name: CET-6 rewrite links the correct draft
cases.user: 同一道六级写作先后写了两篇独立稿，这篇是第一稿看过反馈后的重写。用原判据复评并留档，我下次只按档案恢复。
expect: uses one criterion with evidence
links the rewrite to the first draft by ID
counts the rewrite as assisted and excludes full text without permission
recovers the link and criterion from the draft history
